title: Kiro cloud sessions now reach private networks
text: Kiro cloud sessions can now attach to a VPC that your admin configures. Until now, a cloud session could reach the public internet and Kiro’s own services, but nothing inside your private network, so an agent could not install from an internal package mirror, run integration tests against a database with no public address, or call a build server that only answers from inside your perimeter. Starting today, an admin registers a VPC once, every cloud session created afterward joins it automatically, and your own network decides what those sessions can reach. You also control the agent’s internet access because everything except Kiro’s own traffic leaves through your VPC. VPC connections are available on Enterprise plans for IAM Identity Center profiles.
